demoData: Sem dados operacionais; textos são os rótulos existentes dos fluxos de acesso.
prompt:
Create a premium visual design board image, landscape 1600x1000, showing FOUR distinct desktop web page mockups for the existing GO Itaim "Dashboard Geral" account flows, arranged as a clean 2x2 grid with generous gutters. Each quadrant is its own full web page canvas (no browser chrome or computer frame), clearly titled in a tiny folio tab outside the UI: LOGIN, CRIAR CONTA, RECUPERAR SENHA, NOVA SENHA. Keep each form spacious, calm and practical; no invented flows or controls.

Chosen visual direction "Folhas de Operação": warm ivory paper, graphite text, confident cobalt blue rules and primary buttons, small chrome-yellow divider tabs, one tiny muted red accent, hairline ruled borders, restrained translucent acetate card surfaces. Editorial manual-inspired hierarchy, precise aligned fields, strong accessibility contrast; no blue/purple glow gradients, no abstract blobs, no glassy luxury treatment. Use the provided official logo reference in each screen as the GO Itaim brand mark, retain the product name "Dashboard Geral"; do not redraw or rename the brand. Match the accompanying approved overview mockup for spacing, type and material character.

SCREEN 1 LOGIN: GO Itaim logo and Dashboard Geral, heading "Bem-vindo de volta", text "Entre com suas credenciais para continuar", Email field with placeholder "seu@email.com", Senha field, "Esqueci minha senha", cobalt button "Entrar", bottom line "Não tem uma conta? Criar conta".
SCREEN 2 CRIAR CONTA: same identity, heading "Criar Conta", subheading "Seus Dados", helper "Preencha os campos para criar sua conta", fields "Nome Completo", "Email", "Senha", "Confirmar Senha", visible password strength indicator, button "Criar Conta", link "Já tem uma conta? Fazer login".
SCREEN 3 RECUPERAR SENHA: heading "Recuperar Senha", helper "Digite seu email para receber o link de redefinição", Email field, button "Enviar Link", link "Voltar para o Login".
SCREEN 4 NOVA SENHA: heading "Nova Senha", helper "Crie uma senha forte para sua conta", fields "Senha" and "Confirmar Senha", visible strength indicator, button "Redefinir Senha".

Use exact Portuguese strings and crisp, readable typography. The four panels are design previews for existing pages and states, not a screenshot of a single combined app. No fake testimonials, no new company claims, no browser elements, no sample personal data beyond the field placeholder.
title: Folhas de Operação — Acesso e conta
